prior_hypothesis.hypothesis: Most development mistakes remain infection versus noninfection. Local normal-atlas input projections did not pass M6. Test using fit-normal feature groups as a training risk constraint instead: within each true coarse class, equalize patient-weighted losses across inferred normal-coordinate groups. These are feature groups, not hospital/site labels. Risk variance regularization is an existing principle; no methodological novelty claim.
prior_hypothesis.geometry: Original fit-only standardization and normal-patient PCA32 of four streams. Deterministic farthest-initialized2/4clusters in whitened global normal-patientPCA32coordinates; Lloyd max100 andconvergenceassert. Hard nearest-cluster group for each fitting/queryimage. Groupfitusesonlynormalpatientcenters. Freeze16arm/phasegeometries and16patientplans beforeallMLPfits.
prior_hypothesis.architecture: Original full normal-reference attentionMLP and complete task; add lambda .1/.5 times mean across present coarseclasses of population variance of classconditional group smoothed coarseNLLrisk. Group risk is normalized by sum of originalpatient/classbalanced weights within group/class; absent groups excluded,onepresentgroupvariance0. No new trainable parameters,identicalinit/RNG/hparams/patientweights/3seeds. Inference remains deterministic normal-referenceMLP.4arms48actualheads,4fixed.75new/.25M5fusions8scores0fusionfits.
